messages:
nina_support: Escalating to CS: Clearpath Diagnostics trial blocked at onboarding due to bulk ingest failing with TokenizationError. Customer is concerned about trial timeline and potential renewal impact.

maya_cs: Thx. Paste the smallest error snippet and confirm if support thinks it's our runtime or customer payload. We need to message customer within 30m. @oliver_csm FYI on renewal risk.

nina_support: Snippet: `2026-04-02T08:07:11Z ERROR ingest: TokenizationError: invalid byte sequence at 1204` Support suspects malformed upstream data (null bytes/charset). Triage estimate 1-3h.

maya_cs: Proposed comms plan: 1) immediate ack with 2h investigation ETA, 2) offer 30m troubleshooting call, 3) offer manual CSV fallback and one-time onboarding credit if delay affects scheduled demo. Approve?

jordan_pm: Approve. I'll draft a short pre-ingest checklist and a tiny validation script to reduce recurrence. Recommend we update trial onboarding email after.

liam_se: Tech note: usually stray `\x00` or non-UTF8 blobs. I'll attach a sanitize script (removes nulls + normalizes unicode) and a minimal repro. If they can't run it, CS can send CSV to support and we'll ingest server-side.

maya_cs: Owners: nina_support (ticket updates), liam_se (sanitize + repro), jordan_pm (checklist + enablement doc), maya_cs/oliver_csm (customer comms + credit decision). Timeline: ack in 30m, investigation update in 2h, remediation options in 6h.

nina_support: Sending ack now: "Thanks 9 Clearpath  we're investigating a tokenizer error; ETA 2 hours. We can run a quick sanitize or accept a CSV fallback to keep your trial moving. Would you prefer a quick call or CSV upload?"

escalation_bot: Runbook entry created: https://console.redwood/escalations/1768889999 (priority: trial-impact, renewal-watch).

oliver_csm: Customer replied: prefers CSV fallback to keep demo on schedule. They also asked for a follow-up call after ingestion to confirm results.

liam_se: Ran sanitize on sample they uploaded, found null bytes in two files. Sanitized sample ingested successfully. Pushing script to ticket and to enablement repo.

maya_cs: Customer trial unblocked via CSV fallback. Follow-ups: jordan_pm to add checklist to onboarding materials, liam_se to PR sanitize script, nina_support to close ticket and note credit eligibility for demo delay. Marking escalation resolved. :thumbsup:
